risks.title: Past performance not indicative of future results
risks.summary: Past performance of managed funds does not guarantee future results and could negatively impact revenues and investor confidence.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the 10-K and repeated multiple times with strong language (not necessarily indicative, could cause a decline). It directly affects investor perception and revenues. The Capital category is highly weighted. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased competition for investment opportunities
risks.summary: The rise in capital in alternative markets reduces access to attractive investment opportunities, threatening future growth.
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights increased competition in private markets and credit markets. The language is repeated and emphasizes a direct impact on future returns. Central placement in the document. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Loss of clients in custom management services
risks.summary: The absence of long-term contracts in custom management services exposes the company to sudden revenue loss if clients leave.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as materially and adversely affect with contracts terminable within 30-90 days. Mention of periodic renewal of public contracts, increasing vulnerability. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Conflicts of interest in advisory and allocation decisions
risks.summary: Conflicts between clients, affiliated funds, and shareholders could lead to litigation, fines, or reputational damage.
risks.score_rationale: Strong language: material adverse effect on our reputation, regulatory enforcement, fiduciary duty. Risk related to SEC and legal obligations. Regulation category is highly critical. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Departure of key personnel or key event
risks.summary: The loss of a key executive could suspend fund operations and severely harm performance and client relationships.
risks.score_rationale: Mention of a key person event that could suspend the investment period. Alarming language: materially and adversely affect. High placement in the document and direct operational impact. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Expansion into retail investors and tokenization
risks.summary: Entry into the retail investor market via tokenization increases regulatory, legal, and reputational risks.
risks.score_rationale: New initiative exposing the company to greater levels of risk. Strong language: heightened litigation, regulatory enforcement and reputational risks. Technology category with cross-cutting impact. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: High redemptions in evergreen funds
risks.summary: Large-scale redemptions in evergreen funds could harm their attractiveness and reduce revenues, especially during periods of market stress.
risks.score_rationale: Risk related to difficult market conditions and redemption limits. Mention of reputational harm and impact on cash flows. Positioned toward the end of the document but with significant language. (default score, to be refined)
